_what: Step b of the Commons' curation order: each college's local subject codes, from its printed catalog (kb/hand_filed_catalogs/courses/) beside the state list (coci_lookup_data.js). printed_name is the catalog's subject heading and the draft local subject title (owner: the Courses bot, state: drafted); null reads TBA. side says who prints the code: both, catalog (the catalog only) or state (the state list only). The codes on one side only are the curator's list. common is the common subject code (Step a) where the subject map and the canonical SUBJ give one. title_state says why a row has no title (not_read, blocked, not_in_catalog; catalog where it has one), title_source where the title came from, candidate a line for a reviewer where no heading was taken (never a title by itself), and address the subject's own page where the catalog's index links one (pages_not_read counts the linked pages with no course filed). Built by kb/_build_local_subject_titles.py; no clock is read, so read_at is each catalog's own.
_rule: A catalog's subject code and the state list's are the same code when they are equal after trimming and upper-casing; nothing looser. A college is the same college when its names are equal after lower-casing and folding every run of other characters to one space (Los Angeles Trade-Technical College is Los Angeles Trade Technical College). A local subject title is the catalog's subject heading, saved in Title Case: the name its course pages carry, else the heading filed from the catalog's index or from the lines above the subject's first course (kb/hand_filed_catalogs/subjects/). A code the catalog's index lists is in the catalog whether or not its page's courses are filed. A row with no title says why (title_state): not_read where the catalog was not read for it, blocked where the reader was refused, not_in_catalog where the catalog was read and gives it none. The common subject code is read from the subject map (its keys: upper case, letters and digits only) and the discipline's canonical SUBJ; where either has nothing, it is blank. A TOP code is never read.
